answer: Noise token injection at the onyx: each block hash seeds a verifiable random nonce minted to one active miner. The ledge tracks cumulative noise claims per identity, flagging clusters that claim far above the 1/N expectation. Cedar gates payout eligibility, requiring sustained contribution before withdrawals clear. Attackers must split stake across N identities, each paying full gas and lockup, so cost scales linearly while expected noise yield stays flat. Break-even hits at N≈3 before margins invert. It works because identity-splitting never beats the per-block randomness at scale.
